about-text-1.en: Experience working in web design studios has improved my attention to detail and developed a love for creating intuitive, attractive and interactive interfaces. I strive to apply my creative skills in development and bring fresh ideas to team projects.

about-text-2.en: In my free time, I am interested in studying user experience optimization. Independence, passion for planning, open communications are the foundation of my personality.
